title: The minimal approach to online EFL classes in a low-resourced school context
core_idea: To shed light on the understudied realities of EFL teaching in low-resourced private schools by examining minimal, tool-mediated approaches to online instruction during emergencies through a phenomenological case study.
tldr: A four-month interpretive phenomenological case study using semi-structured interviews, recorded classes, and documents to investigate minimal online EFL approaches in a low-resourced private school context during emergencies.
